LESSON: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Modes of preservation of the Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Modes of preservation of the Qur’an. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Modes of preservation of the Qur’an helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN
Study Modes of preservation of the Qur’an like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Modes of preservation of the Qur’an” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

What this means
In this part you learn to recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Modes of preservation of the Qur’an in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Modes of preservation of the Qur’an is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Modes of preservation of the Qur’an” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Modes of preservation of the Qur’an in your own words. (skill: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity.
3. Practise this skill: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Modes of preservation of the Qur’an: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Modes of preservation of the Qur’an?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?
2. How is the Qur’an preserved in modern times?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Modes of preservation of the Qur’an means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity.
5. Be able to: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
